title: HueFinder
description: HueFinder adds a clean in-game menu to browse and search color palettes for creative building.
body:
# 🎨 HueFinder **The Ultimate Color Palette Browser for Minecraft Artists!** [![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1--1.21.8-brightgreen.svg)](https://www.minecraft.net/) [![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-Compatible-blue.svg)](https://fabricmc.net/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [📥 Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/huefinder)
--- ## ✨ What is HueFinder? **HueFinder** is a beautiful, intuitive color palette browser designed specifically for Minecraft builders. Struggling to find the perfect color combinations for your Art? HueFinder provides **18+ hand-curated color palettes** right at your fingertips with a single keypress! ### 🎯 Perfect For: - 🏗️ **Builders** looking for color inspiration - 🎨 **Creative minds** planning their next masterpiece - 🌈 **Designers** who want cohesive color palettes - 🔍 **Anyone** tired of browsing through hundreds of colors --- ## 🌟 Key Features ### 📚 Amazing Color Palettes Access **18+ professionally designed palettes** including: - 🌊 **Ocean Depths** - Deep sea blues and teals - 🌅 **Sunset Glow** - Warm evening oranges and reds - 🌲 **Forest Canopy** - Natural greens and earth tones - 👑 **Royal Purple** - Majestic purples and magentas - 🖤 **Monochrome Minimal** - Clean blacks, whites, and grays - 💡 **Neon City** - Vibrant cyberpunk colors - 🍬 **Pastel Dream** - Soft, gentle hues - 🏜️ **Desert Sands** - Warm sandy browns - 🔥 **Fire Gradient** - Hot flame transitions - ...and many more! ### 🔍 Smart Search & Filter - **Real-time search** by color or mood name - **Category filters**: Featured, Popular, Monochrome, Gradient, Pastel, Neon, and more - **Instant results** as you type ### 🎨 Beautiful Interface - **Clean, modern UI** with smooth animations - **Hover to preview** hex codes for each color - **Click to copy** entire palette info to clipboard - **Responsive design** that adapts to any screen size --- ### How to Use 1. Press **`H`** (or your custom keybind) to open HueFinder 2. Browse palettes or use the search bar 3. Click any category to filter palettes 4. Hover over colors to see hex codes 5. Click a palette to copy its info to clipboard! --- ## 🎨 Palette Categories | Category | Icon | Description | |----------|------|-------------| | **All Palettes** | 📚 | View all available palettes | | **Featured** | ✨ | Hand-picked highlights | | **Popular** | 🔥 | Community favorites | | **Recommended** | ⭐ | Great for beginners | | **Monochrome** | ⚫ | Single-color variations | | **Gradient** | 🌈 | Smooth color transitions | | **Pastel** | 🎨 | Soft, muted tones | | **Neon** | 💡 | Vibrant, electric colors | --- ## ⚙️ Configuration HueFinder works out of the box, but you can customize: - **Keybinding**: Change the open key in Minecraft's Controls menu - **Search**: Use keywords like "ocean", "warm", "blue", "gradient" - **Categories**: Filter by mood or style --- ## 🤝 Compatibility ### ✅ Works With - All Fabric mods - Sodium & optimization mods - Resource packs & shaders - Multiplayer (client-side only) ### ⚠️ Not Compatible With - Forge (Fabric only) - Quilt (untested, may work) --- ## 🐛 Known Issues Currently, there are no known issues! If you find a bug: 1. Check if you're using the latest version 2. Make sure Fabric API is installed --- ## 🗺️ Roadmap ### Upcoming Features - [ ] 🎨 50+ total palettes - [ ] 💾 Save favorite palettes - [ ] 🌐 Multi-language support - [ ] 🎯 In-game color picker - [ ] 🤝 Community palette sharing **Have a suggestion?** --- ## 👤 Credits ### Development **Created by Artifyz - 🎨 Design & Development - 💻 Programming - 🌈 Palette Curation ### Special Thanks - The **Fabric** team for the amazing modding framework - The **Minecraft** community for inspiration - **You** for downloading! 💚 --- ## 📞 Contact & Links - 📦 **Modrinth**: [HueFinder](https://modrinth.com/mod/huefinder) --- ## 🎉 Thank You! Thank you for using HueFinder! We hope it makes your building experience more colorful and enjoyable. Happy building! 🏗️✨
